text:
[LCYC.2.4.2] Two rules, each of which calls a service whose response
fact or `CallError` the other matches by correlation, form a cycle: each rule's
RHS triggers the other's LHS via the call's outcome ([LCYC.3.2.2]). A rule
that matches the outcome of its own call under the same correlation is a
one-rule cycle. `cooldown` bounds the rate but
doesn't prevent the cycle — once started, the
loop continues indefinitely at the cooldown
cadence.
